+Default ``FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS`` setting changed from ``None`` to ``0o644``
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+Without a consistent umask setting, the permissions for a file uploaded to
+``FileSystemStorage`` could vary based on whether ``MemoryUploadedFile`` or
+``TemporaryUploadedFile`` was used for temporary storage of the uploaded data
+(as determined by :setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE`). The new default
+value of the setting avoids this inconsistency.
+
